'''Hardened circuits''' were a type of [[hydraulic control circuit]]s available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were produced by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] and cost 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
